Hi all — quick note from ops:

- Portal enrollment: we can create Greenline's portal collector ID within 48 business hours once we receive the completed enrollment form. That ID is what our billing system will push to; AP teams can map it to their inbound rules.
- VAT fields: our push includes 'Tax ID (VAT)', 'VAT reverse charge flag' and 'Billing legal entity'. We map the attached VAT_certificate file to the VAT field during onboarding if you confirm the scanned copy is final.
- Fallback: we can auto-send a PDF copy to ap@greenlinehealth.com if the portal push fails.

Olivia — I'll attach the enrollment form and a sample pushed payload. Marissa & Connor, please confirm you'd like us to enable the email copy for the first 3 invoices (recommended).
